items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf); McVay says felt lack of power/explosion, will test pregame. Major DFS/slate swing if OUT.
items.why: Calf issue Thursday practice; majority Thursday but no Friday; pregame test.
items.implication: If OUT, TE-heavy hierarchy (Higbee lead) and elevated secondary WRs; Stafford volume redistributes.
items.opportunity: TE target share spiked to 37% in prior Puka absences; Higbee/Parkinson/Atwell upside.

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle/high ankle); limited practice, 'headed in right direction' but game-time possible vs CIN.
items.why: Returned limited; optimistic comments but coach undecided.
items.implication: If OUT, Huntley start; Ravens offense downgrade, Flowers/Henry impact.
items.opportunity: If ACTIVE, full Lamar upside restored.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad); limited return to practice after multi-week absence. Crucial for Jets-MIA slate.
items.why: Limited practice Thursday/Friday after missing games.
items.implication: If OUT, Braelon Allen locked RB1 vs soft MIA; if IN, committee likely but startable.
items.opportunity: Allen high snap/attempt shares in absences; MIA boosts RBs via receiving.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); unlocks full Bijan workload vs SF.
items.implication: Bijan bellcow; SF DvP inflates opposing RBs +4.4%.
items.opportunity: Bijan full snaps/carries/RZ vs soft SF run D recently generous to RBs.

items.text: Official OUTs include Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Brian Robinson, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, David Montgomery, Jeremiyah Love, Rashee Rice, Zach Charbonnet, Davante Adams et al.
items.implication: Confirms ETR dump; multiple beneficiary spots open.

items.text: Mike Evans OUT (Achilles/ribs); confirmed by coach Shanahan. 49ers WR corps further depleted.
items.implication: Kittle funnel + CMC slot usage temptation; remaining WRs elevated.
items.opportunity: Kittle target spike; CMC more routes/slot amid WR injuries.

items.text: Deebo Samuel OUT (hamstring); pairs with Evans OUT for 49ers.
items.implication: Further concentrates targets to Kittle/CMC; WR depth crisis.
items.opportunity: Kittle/CMC role expansion; any healthy WR handcuff.

items.text: Davante Adams OUT (hamstring, multi-week); compounds Puka Q for Rams.
items.implication: Rams TE-heavy (37% prior Puka-out share); Higbee lead if Puka also sits.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT (hamstring); confirmed in Schefter OUT list.
items.implication: Worthy/Kelce/others absorb KC targets vs SEA.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love OUT (high-ankle); coach LaFleur ruled out another week.
items.implication: ARI RB committee (Allgeier/Knight) full workload vs DEN.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin); listed with Jahwar Jordan.
items.implication: HOU RB handcuffs (e.g. Marks) elevated vs NYG.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka OUT (concussion/foot); sneaky important scratch per Levitan.
items.implication: TB WR targets to others; Mayfield Q but ready.

items.text: Tyler Warren OUT (groin); Colts TE scratch, sneaky per Levitan.
items.opportunity: Backup TE or WR target bump.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN; facility access (meetings/lifting/medical) noted earlier by Levitan as positive.
items.implication: Possible start but Berry hates post-layoff; monitor snaps.
items.opportunity: If limited, Lloyd/Johnson but they rank poorly EPA.
items.conflict: Berry HATE vs ETR IN/Levitan long-term positive.
